 has fallen around 21% from $0.17 to $0.14 since the beginning of the year. Dogecoin is off its 200-day SMA of $0.21 by 33.3%.

the 200-day SMA serves as a way for traders and investors to identify whether a cryptocurrency or equity is in a bull or bear market.
